text:
hannah: Heads up  light spritz turning into steady drizzle on the Bay Bridge. Took me +20m this morning, traffic creeping in both directions. Anyone else seeing bridge backups?

raj: Yep saw backup on the westbound approach. Camera shows a tanker pulled over near the toll plaza causing a squeeze. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:

mel: I detoured via I-980 and took 24 across  longer mileage but faster this AM. FYI the 4th St onramp is slick so take it slow if you're rerouting.

cory: Ferry-bot: Ferry status: 07:30 departure from Alameda delayed 12m due to docking congestion. Suggest alternative: 07:50 run.

hannah: Thanks ferry-bot  good to know. Is the 07:50 usually packed? Trying to decide if I should wait or head to the office.

tasha: 07:50 is hit-or-miss. If you need to be at a desk by 9, consider leaving 10-15m earlier than usual. Also lobby umbrella stash by reception has one bright yellow brolly if you need it.

raj: quick poll  what are you doing if the bridge is still bad at 8:00? react: :ferry: take ferry, :detour: reroute, :home: WFH/remote, :uber: rideshare

mel: :detour:

hannah: :ferry:

tasha: :home:

cory: ferry-bot: Reminder: Clipper readers accepting mobile payments; if you forgot your card, you can still tap with your phone.

raj: also saw a tweet that Muni is doing temporary bus bridging on 3rd St for a partial outage. Might be useful if you usually cut across SoMa.

mel: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/umbrella-rain-3o6ZsY7rJ7b9 (mood)

hannah: Appreciate the intel. If anyone's coming by the Mission office around 8:45 and can snag the yellow umbrella for me, please DM  I'll leave a coffee.

tasha: I can grab it and leave it at reception. Coffee sounds good. :coffee:

ferry-bot: Update: 07:30 Alameda departure now estimated +18m. Next departure 07:50 on schedule.

raj: Thanks all. Stay dry and safe out there. Ping here with live updates if anything changes.
